verses.1: For there will be a place in the land that Jehovah your God will give you to possess. It will be a place that lies in the wilderness, and no one will know who owns it.
verses.2: And your elders and judges shall go out and judge those cities that are located around the valley.
verses.3: And the city that was located near the wilderness was taken away. The elders of that city were carried away in a cart that wasn’t used for worshiping or storing anything in it.
verses.4: And the elders of that city carried the calf to the stream of Eitan. They said that it should not be used for worship or sacrifice. So they burned the calf there, in the stream.
verses.5: And the priests shall approach the sons of Levi. For in them has Jehovah your God chosen those who will serve Him and bless in His name. And upon their lips shall be all kinds of blessings.
verses.6: And all the elders of that city went into the wilderness, and they washed their hands in the stream that flowed there.
verses.7: And they answered, “Our hands have not spilled this blood, and our eyes have not seen it.”
verses.8: May the blood of your people, Israel, be avenged by God. Do not allow innocent blood to be shed among your people, Israel. May their blood be avenged.
verses.9: And you shall pour out that clean blood from your wounds, as if you were doing what is right in the eyes of Jehovah.
verses.10: For you will go out to battle against your enemies, and Jehovah your God will give you victory in your hands. Then you will destroy Shibyo.
verses.11: And you saw in the valley a beautiful woman with fair hair. You were attracted to her, and you took her as your wife.
verses.12: And you brought her inside your house, and you cut off her head. Then you made her into a crown.
verses.13: And she shall take off her veil from her face. Then she shall enter your house. She shall mourn over her father and mother for seven days. After that, she shall come back to her husband, and she will become your wife.
verses.14: And if you do not desire her, and send her away from your heart, then she shall not be sold for money. She shall not be hidden under anything that you have given her as a gift.
verses.15: For she would become the wife of a man who had two wives: one was loved, and the other was despised. They would have children together. The beloved wife would give birth to sons, while the despised wife would give birth to daughters. And the son of the despised wife would be the heir to her estate.
verses.16: And on the day he would give birth to his children, he would not be able to kiss the beloved child in front of the rejected child.
verses.17: For the firstborn son of the widow will be recognized as worthy of receiving two portions from everything that is given to him. For he is the beginning of all judgments regarding inheritance.
verses.18: For a man who has a son who is cruel and violent, he will not listen to the voice of his father or mother. He will also kill him, and he will not listen to them at all.
verses.19: And his father and mother released him. They brought him before the elders of the city and to the gate where he was located.
verses.20: And they said to the elders of the city, “This man is a scoundrel and a liar. He doesn’t listen to our words. He’s a thief and a liar.”
verses.21: And all the people of his city will be destroyed by stones. They will die in that evil place far from you. And all of Israel will hear and fear.
verses.22: And if there is a man who has committed a sin that leads to death, then he shall be hanged on a tree.
verses.23: Do not lay his body on the tree, for that day will come when we will be buried too. It is an act of blasphemy to lay someone’s body on a tree. Do not desecrate the land that Yahweh, your God, has given you as a inheritance.
